name: Sonauto
tagline: Free AI music generator that turns prompts, lyrics, or melodies into full songs.
description: Sonauto generates complete, radio-quality songs — vocals and instrumentals — from a text prompt, your own lyrics, or a hummed melody. It is powered by Melodia, the company's in-house music foundation model, and ships a developer API alongside the web app. A free tier is available with paid credit plans for higher volume and commercial use.
